info.title: CW Ticket Tools v12
info.description: Count, search, and retrieve ConnectWise Manage ticket notes using JSON text filters. Supports ticket priority filters such as P1, Priority 1, Critical, and Emergency.

BearerAuth.name: Authorization
BearerAuth.description: Enter the API token as "Bearer YOUR_TOKEN".

post.description:
Counts ConnectWise Manage tickets. Use for how many/count/total questions. Use entity ticket.

Generate filters_json as a JSON array string. Each filter object must have field, operator, and value.

Supported filter fields:
- company: use contains for customer/client/company names.
- summary: use contains only when the user specifically asks for words/text in the ticket summary.
- status: use semantic_eq open for open tickets. Use semantic_eq closed for closed tickets.
- priority: use eq for ticket priority. For P1, Priority 1, Critical, Emergency, or urgent tickets, use {"field":"priority","operator":"eq","value":"P1"}.
- board: use contains for board names.
- owner: use contains for ticket owner/member names.
- date_entered: use gte/lte for created date filters.
- last_updated: use gte/lte for updated date filters.

Important:
- Do not treat P1, Priority 1, Critical, Emergency, or urgent as summary text unless the user explicitly says "summary contains P1".
- For "open P1 tickets", use both filters:
  [{"field":"priority","operator":"eq","value":"P1"},{"field":"status","operator":"semantic_eq","value":"open"}]

Examples:
- How many open P1 tickets are there?
  filters_json = [{"field":"priority","operator":"eq","value":"P1"},{"field":"status","operator":"semantic_eq","value":"open"}]
- How many SentinelOne tickets are open?
  filters_json = [{"field":"summary","operator":"contains","value":"SentinelOne"},{"field":"status","operator":"semantic_eq","value":"open"}]
- How many tickets for Oaklawn?
  filters_json = [{"field":"company","operator":"contains","value":"Oaklawn"}]

Searches ConnectWise Manage tickets. Use for find/show/list/retrieve ticket questions. Use entity ticket.

Generate filters_json as a JSON array string. Each filter object must have field, operator, and value.

Supported filter fields:
- company: use contains for customer/client/company names.
- summary: use contains only when the user specifically asks for words/text in the ticket summary.
- status: use semantic_eq open for open tickets. Use semantic_eq closed for closed tickets.
- priority: use eq for ticket priority. For P1, Priority 1, Critical, Emergency, or urgent tickets, use {"field":"priority","operator":"eq","value":"P1"}.
- board: use contains for board names.
- owner: use contains for ticket owner/member names.
- date_entered: use gte/lte for created date filters.
- last_updated: use gte/lte for updated date filters.

Important:
- Do not treat P1, Priority 1, Critical, Emergency, or urgent as summary text unless the user explicitly says "summary contains P1".
- For "open P1 tickets", use both filters:
  [{"field":"priority","operator":"eq","value":"P1"},{"field":"status","operator":"semantic_eq","value":"open"}]

Use select_json when fields are requested or helpful.
Good default select_json:
["id","company.name","summary","status.name","urgency.name","date_entered","last_updated"]

For "list open P1 ticket numbers", use:
filters_json = [{"field":"priority","operator":"eq","value":"P1"},{"field":"status","operator":"semantic_eq","value":"open"}]
select_json = ["id","company.name","summary","status.name","urgency.name"]

CopilotCountRequest.description: Count ticket request with JSON text filters.

filters_json.description:
JSON array string of filter objects. Each object has field, operator, and value.

Supported fields: company, summary, status, priority, board, owner, date_entered, last_updated.

Priority examples:
[{"field":"priority","operator":"eq","value":"P1"}]
[{"field":"priority","operator":"eq","value":"P1"},{"field":"status","operator":"semantic_eq","value":"open"}]

Do not use summary contains P1 unless the user explicitly asks for P1 in the summary.

CopilotSearchRequest.description: Search ticket request with optional JSON text filters, fields, and sorting.

filters_json.description:
Optional JSON array string of filter objects. Omit when the user does not ask for filtering.

Supported fields: company, summary, status, priority, board, owner, date_entered, last_updated.

For P1/Priority 1/Critical/Emergency tickets, use:
[{"field":"priority","operator":"eq","value":"P1"}]

For open P1 tickets, use:
[{"field":"priority","operator":"eq","value":"P1"},{"field":"status","operator":"semantic_eq","value":"open"}]

Do not use summary contains P1 unless the user explicitly asks for P1 in the summary.

select_json.description:
Optional JSON array string of fields to return. Omit unless needed.

Good default:
["id","company.name","summary","status.name","urgency.name","date_entered","last_updated"]

For ticket numbers only, use:
["id"]

For listing open P1 tickets, use:
["id","company.name","summary","status.name","urgency.name"]

order_by_json.description: Optional JSON array string of sort objects. Omit unless sorting is requested. Example: [{"field":"last_updated","direction":"desc"}]

limit.description: Maximum number of ticket rows to return. Use 10 unless the user asks for another amount.

CopilotNotesRequest.description: Ticket notes request with JSON text filters.

filters_json.description:
JSON array string of filter objects used to find matching tickets before retrieving notes.

Supported fields: company, summary, status, priority, board, owner, date_entered, last_updated.

For P1/Priority 1/Critical/Emergency tickets, use:
[{"field":"priority","operator":"eq","value":"P1"}]

For open P1 tickets, use:
[{"field":"priority","operator":"eq","value":"P1"},{"field":"status","operator":"semantic_eq","value":"open"}]

limit_tickets.description: Maximum number of matching tickets to collect notes from. Use 5 unless the user asks for more.

limit_notes.description: Maximum number of notes to return. Use 25 unless the user asks for more.

include_internal.description: Whether to include internal notes. Use true unless the user asks for public/customer notes only.
